question: Chandragiri was the last capital of Vijayanagara Kings. Chandragiri Fort is located in which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Andhra Pradesh.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** mediaeval fort known as Chandragiri Fort** was constructed in the **eleventh century and may be found in Chandragiri,** Tirupati, Andhra Pradesh, India. It was constructed considerably earlier, in the** 11th century,** by the Yadava kings, despite being primarily identified with the **Vijayanagara Emperors.**
 
• **Chandragiri, the fourth capital of the Vijayanagar Empire **in 1460 A.D., is best known for its historical fort, which dates back to the 11th century, as well as the Raja and Rani Palaces that are housed inside. The fort was captured by the** Golkonda region in 1646,** after which it came under **Mysore authority.**
 
• The ruling monarch was overthrown by **Saluva Narasimha Deva Raya,** the Vijayanagara governor of Chandragiri, in the 15th century CE, ending the **Sangama lineage's sway **and establishing the Saluvas'. Following him was Krishna Deva Raya of the** Tuluva dynasty. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ​After around three centuries of royal reign,** Chandragiri** came under the dominion of the** Vijayanagarayadava kings in 1367.**
 
• **Vyasatirtha,** who had lived here and served as **King Saluva Narasimha Deva Raya's spiritual **counsellor, was given control over worship at the** Tirumala temple.**
 
• At **Narasimha Raya II's court in Chandragiri**, Vyasathirtha remained. The sage chose to live in this fort because it is 11 miles from the well-known **Tirupati Temple **and there is a **footpath that leads there from here.**
